name: Mint: Unblock Car Puzzle
en: A little room. A clever escape. Slide the cars, clear a path for the red car, and find your way through 99 parking puzzles.
cn: 在清新的薄荷小城里，滑动车辆，为红色小车让出通道。挑战 99 道挪车谜题，用更少的步数摘下星星。
tag: 99 道谜题 · 小汽车，大巧思

name: Color Dock: Cargo Puzzle
en: Make room at a colorful harbor. Slide containers to matching exits, plan each move, and enjoy the moment the dock clears.
cn: 把彩色货柜送往同色出口，安排每一步的先后顺序。在 99 个关卡里，一点点腾出空间，享受清空码头的成就感。
tag: 99 个关卡 · 4 种港口主题

name: Lift Dock: Anime Sort Puzzle
zh: 升降机分类与插画收藏
en: A small lift with a big job. Send colorful crates to their matching exits and unlock a new illustration with every completed level.
cn: 小小升降机，装着大大的挑战。合理安排彩色货箱的顺序，送往同色出口；每过一关，解锁一张新的收藏插画。

name: Critter Zones
en: Settle into cozy logic puzzles, collect pixel pets, and return for a fresh daily challenge. A little thinking, a little company.
cn: 在轻松的逻辑谜题里慢慢思考，收集可爱的像素萌宠，再来一局每日挑战。让解谜时光，多一点陪伴。
tag: 像素萌宠 · 每日挑战

name: Cargo Loop: Baggage Sort
en: Every bag has a flight to catch. Dispatch trucks, match luggage to planes, and keep a busy airport conveyor moving.
cn: 每件行李，都有要赶上的航班。选择卡车的出发顺序，把彩色行李送上对应飞机，在有限的传送带空间里规划下一步。
tag: 99 道谜题 · 一座忙碌的小机场

name: Don't Think Normal: Puzzles
zh: 换个思路，答案就不一样
en: Your first answer might be too obvious. Tap, drag, and tilt your way through 60 playful puzzles with unexpected solutions.
cn: 第一眼想到的答案，也许太普通了。试试点击、拖动和倾斜手机，在 60 道脑洞谜题里，发现意料之外的解法。
tag: 60 道谜题 · 意想不到的答案

name: Color Sudoku Garden
en: Let logic bloom. Solve 50 flower sudoku puzzles, collect seeds and grow a garden across five colorful themes.
cn: 让逻辑与花朵一同绽放。挑战 50 个花朵数独关卡，收集种子，在五种主题中打造自己的花园。
tag: 50 个关卡 · 5 种花园主题

name: Whistle Meadow
en: Rotate tracks and guide a wooden toy train through 50 puzzles across five worlds. One purchase, offline play, no ads or in-app purchases.
cn: 旋转轨道，带领木质小火车挑战五个世界的 50 个谜题。一次购买，离线游玩，无广告、无内购。
tag: 50 个关卡 · 木质玩具火车
